name: ai.knowall/reverie
title: Reverie
description: Graph memory that dreams: Neo4j knowledge-graph memory for AI agents with hybrid search

environmentVariables.name: NEO4J_URI
environmentVariables.description: Bolt URI of the Neo4j 5 database, e.g. bolt://localhost:7687

environmentVariables.name: NEO4J_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: Database name (Enterprise only; omit on Community Edition)

environmentVariables.name: REVERIE_EMBEDDINGS
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider for semantic search: local (default, no API key), openai, azure, ollama, voyage or none
